'''Fillio Androu''' was a [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and the partner of [[Linx Mallicker]].

==Biography==
Together with another [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] gunrunner, [[Linx Mallicker]], Finious Androu bought the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] ''[[Lambarian Crab]]'', previously used by smuggler [[Finious Crab]]. The Wroonians discovered two of the three secret smuggling compartments that Crab had used.<ref name="ss">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>

They then began dealing with illegal weapons from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], avoiding the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] because Crab had earned himself some enemies in the local law enforcement agencies and they would recognize the ship. The Wroonians sold their cargo to Imperial officers that liked illegal firearms and to some cells of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="ss" />
